movie.title: Brokeback Mountain
movie.overview: In 1960s Wyoming, two men develop a strong emotional and sexual relationship that endures as a lifelong connection complicating their lives as they get married and start families of their own.

facts: Did you know Brokeback Mountain started as a short story? It was adapted from Annie Proulx's 1997 work, giving it a rich literary foundation!
The powerful script was penned by a duo: Diana Ossana, who also produced the film, and the acclaimed writer Larry McMurtry. Talk about a dream team behind the words!
The film beautifully captures a love story spanning two decades! Specifically, the complex relationship between Ennis and Jack unfolds from 1963 all the way to 1983.
